methods.label: Keyword top-1
methods.description: Selects only the Agent with the largest exact keyword-overlap count.
methods.selectedSetDefinition: A singleton containing the highest exact substring-keyword score; agentOrder breaks ties and tech is the zero-hit fallback.

methods.label: Keyword fan-out
methods.description: Reproduces the pre-MNC-16 route: call every Agent with at least one keyword hit.
methods.selectedSetDefinition: Every Agent whose exact substring-keyword score is greater than zero; tech is selected only when no Agent has a hit.

methods.label: v2 boundary heuristic
methods.description: Standalone reconstruction of teamlead/v2 coverage/cost and coupled-domain routing.
methods.selectedSetDefinition: The ordered subset of keyword/coupling-required Agents that passes v2 class allowance and is retained by its utility/coverage loop, capped by maxAgents; tech is the empty-set fallback.
